Suche Erweiterte Suche Senior QA / Test Engineer (w/m/x/d) ❮ zurück zur letzten Suche MILES Mobility GmbH Berlin, 10629 Vollzeit Auf diesen Job bewerben Join the ride! You assure quality across our consumer mobile app and our business web platform, from test design to production monitoring. You build the automation, define what release- ready means, and contribute to the final human sign-off before each release. We build fast with AI-assisted tooling, so independent, rigorous checking matters more than ever. Your work lets every team ship quickly and with confidence. Note: This role is Berlin based. Your Responsibility Design test strategy and acceptance criteria together with development and product Build and maintain mobile and web end-to-end automation and run it in CI Test APIs and backend services, including contract and data validation Run performance, load and security testing across mobile, web and APIs Assist in release validation and the final human sign-off on every release Set up production monitoring and follow findings through to a fix Effectively deploy and use AI agents Your Experience 5+ years in QA automation, site reliability or a closely related engineering role Proficiency in TypeScript or JavaScript and Python, and a firm grasp of backend, frontend and database concepts Mobile end-to-end automation with Appium, Detox or Maestro on iOS and Android Web end-to-end automation with Playwright; Selenium or Cypress also welcome API, performance and security testing, including OWASP basics, with tools such as Postman and k6 CI pipeline authoring, such as GitLab CI or GitHub Actions, and SQL for data validation Clear bug reports and acceptance criteria that others can act on A valid driving licence (EU category B or equivalent); testing the product includes trips on the road. Highly desired Experience in mobility, logistics or another operations-heavy consumer product Testing payment flows in a consumer or business product Monitoring and observability tooling for production systems Writing test code in Go or another typed backend language GDPR-aware test data handling Accessibility and usability testing Don't tick every box? Get in touch anyway. Your drive to learn and grow matters a lot to us.Benefits Mobility: Choose between monthly MILES credits or the Deutschlandticket. Fitness: Enjoy a subsidized Urban Sports Club membership for your physical and mental well-being. Discounts: Access 1,500+ providers for discounts on sneakers, theater visits, and more. Home Office: Enjoy the flexibility of working from our office in Berlin and from home. Retirement: Secure your financial future with our attractive pension plan. Growth: We prioritize personal development through knowledge sharing and training opportunities (with the support from our HR Team and the Team Leads). Social Impact: We dedicate a portion of our revenue to support regional social projects, actively contributing to the well-being of society and the environment. #milescharity About us OUR VALUES Our MILES values are the basis of our daily work and what makes us a team. They define how we treat each other at MILES and how we strive to bring the best of ourselves to our customers. Here is a brief insight into what you can expect from us in your day-to-day: Passion: Be yourself, have fun, and enjoy what you do. Ownership: Strive for excellence and surprise yourself. Resourceful: Be pragmatic. Use what we have first. Curiosity: Feel free to challenge the status quo and be willing to adapt. Support: Support each other and proactively ask for help. Empathy: Always consider the position others are in. ABOUT MILES We are the leading car sharing provider in Germany and also offer long-term car subscriptions. Thanks to our cooperation and charity activities, part of our turnover goes towards regional and social projects. At MILES, we believe in a world in which mobility is shared, sustainable, and accessible to all. With our offer, we create an alternative to private car ownership, reduce the number of vehicles on the roads, and positively contribute to urban life. Become part of our diverse team, bringing talented people from over 50 countries together, each with their own experiences and ideas. GOOD TO KNOW Don't have a MILES account yet? With the code JOINUS15, you will receive €15 starting credit when you register for the first time. Enjoy the ride!
